name: First scan notebook
author: Beemuu contributors
description: A starter reference pack for recording symptoms and keeping diagnostic evidence together.

articles.title: Record the conditions
articles.body: Write down the symptom, when it occurs, and whether the engine was cold or warm. Save the fault report and available freeze-frame data before changing anything.

articles.title: Keep a diagnostic notebook
articles.body: A fault code is a clue, not a parts replacement instruction. Record each check and its result so you can compare evidence after a repair.

name: Temperature converter
author: Beemuu contributors
description: Convert Celsius values from an exported log to Fahrenheit. A small executable plugin authoring example.
code:
if (!Array.isArray(input.celsius) || input.celsius.length > 1000 || !input.celsius.every(v => typeof v === 'number' && Number.isFinite(v))) throw new Error('Expected up to 1000 numeric Celsius values');
return { fahrenheit: input.celsius.map(value => Math.round((value * 9 / 5 + 32) * 10) / 10) };
